description: Server network interface status (net/get_status): port, switch, VLAN, speed, MAC, link status. Optional port limits the query to one interface (useful when another NIC has no upstream_id).

port.description: Optional physical/logical interface or switch port (e.g. eth0). Omit to query all; if InvAPI fails on an unmapped NIC, retry with a mapped port from get_server.

name: get_network_status
